title: 第六章 老板你火了！
slug: 这个文字冒险游戏绝对有毒
content_zh:
视频发出去需要审核，沐游也就没再理会，转头又去训练起了别的宠物。
一连释放了十次驯兽咒，将另外十只小宠物也训练‘成精’后，沐游对于这段驯兽咒语已经相当熟练。
现在他甚至可以在半秒之内，以超快的语速将咒语默念出来。
不过同时，沐游也发现了，他每释放一次魔法，精神就会变得萎靡一些。
刚开始还不明显，但连续释放了十几次下来，他只感觉脑袋里昏昏涨涨的，还有点恶心反胃的迹象。
“看来魔法也是有限制的，并不能无限使用，一次性用的太多，可能会导致精神透支，严重一点甚至可能直接昏迷。”沐游心想。
确认了这一点后，他也没有再硬撑，跑去厨房胡乱垫了点吃的，便直接回了卧室休息。
巨大的精神消耗下，困意涌来的挡也挡不住，他脑袋刚一沾枕头，就直接陷入了沉睡之中。
沐游不知道的是，在他陷入熟睡的时候，他发布的视频通过了B站审核，随后播放量以一个肉眼可见的速度开始蹿升，短短一个小时，便已经突破一万。
随后他的视频更是被算法抓取，上了B站首页，结果更是一发不可收拾，播放量开始爆炸式增长，后续又被小编手动送上了封推，最后直接在凌晨四点，冲上了热门……
第二天，沐游醒来，第一件事就是摸向枕边的怀表和魔杖。
还好，都在。
昨天发生的一切果然不是梦！
沐游舒了口气，没有立即起床，而是躺在床上，
翻看了几个粉丝的留言才知道，自己昨晚发的那个视频，居然上了热门！
沐游急忙
果然，仅仅一晚上的时间，这视频播放量就超过了五十万！
照这个速度下去，最终播放量达到四百万轻轻松松。
而此时他的粉丝数量，也从一开始的2.3万，猛涨到了9.4万，眼看就要突破十万！
后台已经有一位小编在催促他，让他尽快继续更新这系列的视频，很有爆火的潜力！

这一系列的连锁反应，把沐游都给看愣了。
他是猜到了这个视频可能会受欢迎，但也没想到播放量会这么高啊！
“相信我，看完之后你一定会说卧槽！”热门评论的第一条，下面回复全是‘卧槽’。
“天啊撸，这是怎么做到的？一只仓鼠怎么能这么听话？”某知名主播留言，下方一排‘大师球捕捉’。
“妈呀，会做俯卧撑的仓鼠，大写的服！”
“都说了建国之后不许成精！”
“up主当代德鲁伊石锤了！”
“妈妈问我为什么跪着看视频！”
“打一百个赌，这视频绝对是合成的特效，如果不是，我直播倒立吃翔！”
“楼上标记了，直播间放一个。”
“这视频明显标题党嘛，这怎么可能是十分钟训出来的，训练个半年以上还差不多。”
“回复楼上，视频里这只是仓鼠幼崽，长得很快的，仔细看前后的仓鼠体型，几乎没有变化，说明拍摄时间不会超过一个星期！”
“一个星期也很厉害了，up主难道是专业训宠师？”
“看up主以往的视频，家里好像是开宠物店的，会训宠不奇怪。”
“救命，这可太可爱了啪，谁知道这是哪里的店？我好想去看看！”
“同想去！”
“啊啊啊，这是我家老板的店啊！”一个名为‘淡雅淑香’的ID，相当激动的留言。
“嗯？楼上惊现店员？”
“是的是的，我是店员，店铺就在K市开发区香江路，名叫奇趣宠物店，欢迎大家前来参观！”淡雅淑香。
“咦？离我家不远哎！”

“刚好在K市，明天顺路去看看。”
沐游正看评论看得津津有味，忽然听到楼下传来咣咣的敲门声。
更衣起床，下楼拉开了卷帘门。
结果刚一拉开门，就看到店门口围了一圈人，小雅也混在其中，门一开，所有人都是好奇的往这边看过来。
看到沐游开门，小雅第一个跑进了店里，一脸兴奋的拉着他的袖子：“老板，你火了！”
“咳，淡定，这才刚开始呢。”
沐游强装镇定，实际上他心里也很激动。
这还是两年来的头一次，还没开门就这么多客人在外等着参观。
抬头看了眼时间，刚七点半。
“还有半小时开门，小雅，你去清理鱼缸，我去给鼠子们换沙。今天可是咱们店转型之后的第一天，决不能在环境问题上拉胯。”
“好。”
两人立即行动起来。
换做平时，半小时是绝不可能收拾完的，光是猫猫狗狗的粪便就足够他们头疼了。
但现在不同，出售了所有猫狗后，他们的工作量直接少了七成。
沐游这边手脚麻利的将清理工作完成，接着又去把昨天训练好的十一只小动物，全都提到了大厅中央的宠物展示区域。
这十一只经历过魔法洗礼的动物，分别是五只仓鼠，两只龙猫，两只兔子，一只土拨鼠，和一只金丝雀。
“今天都好好表现知道吗？待会儿要是看到了你们中意的主人，就拼命卖萌，争取直接让人家买回家，你们这辈子就吃喝不愁了。”
“还有最重要的一点，不管发生什么情况，千万别咬人！”
沐游一本正经的给几只小家伙训话，十一只小动物听完后也纷纷做出点头的动作。
动物对话的效果，目前只能对沐游这个施术者有效，也就是说，其他人类想和它们直接交流，它们还是听不懂。

不过，这些小动物开窍之后，智力上已经比同类动物聪明的多，而且昨天沐游训练过的那些动作，它们也已经牢牢，作为家养宠物，绝对是合格的。
此时小雅那边也已经清理完了鱼缸，换上了清水。
看着一切准备做足，沐游这才走到门口，深吸一口气，拉开了玻璃大门。
“各位久等了，欢迎来到奇趣宠物店。”
沐游看着门外等候的一圈人，嘴角微微上扬。
就这么一会功夫，排队的又多了七八个，视频广告的效果，还真是出乎意料的好。
content_en:
The video needs to be reviewed after being sent out, so Mu You ignored it and turned around to train other pets.
After releasing the animal taming spell ten times in a row and training ten other small pets into spirits, Mu You has become quite proficient in this animal taming spell.
Now he can even recite the spell silently at super fast speed within half a second.
But at the same time, Mu You also discovered that every time he released magic, his spirit would become weaker.
It wasn't obvious at first, but after releasing it for more than a dozen times in a row, he only felt dizzy and swollen in his head, and there were also signs of nausea and vomiting.
"It seems that magic has its limits and cannot be used indefinitely. Using too much at one time may lead to mental exhaustion, or even coma in severe cases." Mu You thought to himself.
After confirming this, he didn't hold on any longer and ran to the kitchen to grab some food, then went directly back to the bedroom to rest.
Under the huge mental consumption, he could not stop the influx of sleepiness. As soon as his head touched the pillow, he fell into a deep sleep.
What Mu You didn't know was that when he fell into a deep sleep, the video he posted passed the review of Station B, and then the number of views began to rise at a speed visible to the naked eye. In just one hour, it had exceeded 10,000.
Later, his video was captured by the algorithm and posted on the homepage of Station B. The result was out of control, and the number of views began to increase explosively. Later, the editor manually sent him a ban, and finally became a hot topic at four o'clock in the morning...
The next day, when Mu You woke up, the first thing he did was to touch the pocket watch and wand beside his pillow.
Fortunately, they are all here.
Everything that happened yesterday was indeed not a dream!
Mu You breathed a sigh of relief and did not get up immediately. Instead, he lay on the bed.
After reading several fans' messages, I realized that the video I posted last night had actually become a hit!
Mu You is in a hurry
Sure enough, in just one night, this video was viewed more than half a million times!
If we continue at this rate, the final number of views will easily reach 4 million.
At this time, the number of his fans has soared from 23,000 at the beginning to 94,000, and is about to exceed 100,000!
There was already an editor in the background urging him to continue updating this series of videos as soon as possible. It has the potential to become a hit!
Mu You was stunned by this series of chain reactions.
He guessed that this video might be popular, but he didn't expect that the number of views would be so high!
"Believe me, after reading this, you will definitely say 'f*ck!'" was the first popular comment, and the following replies were all "f*ck".
"Oh my God, how did you do this? How can a hamster be so obedient?" A well-known anchor left a message, with a row of 'Master Ball Capture' below.
"Oh my god, a hamster that can do push-ups, with a capital letter!"
"They all said that after the founding of the People's Republic of China, you are not allowed to become a spirit!"
"The master of the modern druid is stone hammered!"
"Mom asked me why I was kneeling to watch the video!"
"I bet you a hundred dollars that this video is definitely a synthesized special effect. If not, I will live stream the video while standing on my head!"
"It's marked upstairs and one will be placed in the live broadcast room."
"This video is obviously a headline. How could it be possible that it was trained in ten minutes? More than half a year of training is still the same."
"Reply upstairs, this is just a hamster baby in the video. It grows very fast. If you look closely at the size of the hamster before and after, there is almost no change, which means the filming took no more than a week!"
"It's already been amazing after just one week. Is the owner a professional pet trainer?"
"Looking at the past videos of the up owner, it seems that his family owns a pet shop. It's not surprising that he knows how to train pets."
"Help, this is so cute. Who knows where this store is? I really want to check it out!"
"We want to go together!"
"Ah ah ah, this is my boss's shop!" A user with an ID named "Elegance Shuxiang" left a very excited message.
"Huh? A clerk suddenly appeared upstairs?"
"YesYes, I am a store clerk. The store is located on Xiangjiang Road, K City Development Zone. It is called Funny Pet Shop. Everyone is welcome to visit! "Elegant and fragrant.
"Eh? Not far from my home! "
“I happen to be in K City, I’ll stop by tomorrow to have a look. "
Mu You was reading the comments with interest when he suddenly heard a knock on the door downstairs.
After dressing and getting up, I went downstairs and opened the rolling shutter door.
As soon as he opened the door, he saw a circle of people gathered in front of the store, and Xiaoya was among them. As soon as the door opened, everyone looked over curiously.
Seeing Mu You open the door, Xiaoya was the first to run into the store, pulling his sleeves with excitement: "Boss, you're on fire! "
"Ahem, calm down, this is just the beginning. "
Mu You pretended to be calm, but in fact he was very excited.
This is the first time in two years that there are so many customers waiting to visit before the doors open.
I looked up at the time, it was just half past seven.
"The door opens in half an hour, Xiaoya, you go clean the fish tank, and I'll change the sand for the mice. Today is the first day after the transformation of our store, and we must not be lax about environmental issues. "
"good. "
The two immediately took action.
Normally, it would have been impossible to clean up in half an hour. Just the feces of cats and dogs would be enough to give them a headache.
But it’s different now. After selling all the cats and dogs, their workload has been reduced by 70%.
Mu You quickly completed the cleaning work, and then moved all the eleven small animals trained yesterday to the pet display area in the center of the hall.
The eleven animals that have experienced the baptism of magic are five hamsters, two chinchillas, two rabbits, a groundhog, and a canary.
"Behave well today, you know? Later, if you see the owner you like, act cute and try to get someone to buy it directly and take it home. You will have nothing to worry about in your life. "
“And the most important thing is, no matter what happens, don’t bite! "
Mu You lectured a few little ones in a serious manner, and the eleven little animals also nodded after listening.
The effect of animal dialogue is currently only effective for Mu You, the caster. In other words, if other humans want to communicate directly with them, they still can't understand it.
However, after these little animals have awakened, they are already much smarter than similar animals, and they have firmly mastered the movements that Mu You trained yesterday. They are definitely qualified as household pets.
At this time, Xiaoya had also finished cleaning the fish tank and replaced it with fresh water.
Seeing that everything was ready, Mu You walked to the door, took a deep breath, and opened the glass door.
“Everyone has been waiting for a long time, welcome to the Funny Pet Shop. "
Mu You looked at the circle of people waiting outside the door and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.
In just a short time, seven or eight more people lined up. The effect of the video advertisement was really unexpectedly good.
